title: Scaffolding Rigid Body Rolling Dynamics from Kinematics to Incline Acceleration and Friction Thresholds
physical_system: Symmetric homogeneous rigid bodies (radius R, mass M, radius of gyration k) on planar horizontal and inclined surfaces under gravity g and static friction mu
pedagogical_objective: Master the progressive transition from pure rolling no-slip kinematic constraints to dynamic incline acceleration, energy distribution, and friction threshold boundaries.

rungs.level_name: Direct Application of Rotational Kinematics and Angular Momentum
rungs.physical_delta: Baseline particle motion near earth's surface evaluating angular momentum about fixed external reference point.
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Vector cross product r x p for rectilinear accelerated motion

rungs.level_name: Qualitative Rotational Dynamics and System Mass Redistribution
rungs.physical_delta: Transition from point particle to rotating extended rigid disc with dropped mass altering system moment of inertia.
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Qualitative ratio comparison of initial and final angular velocity

rungs.level_name: Quantitative Conservation of Angular Momentum and Internal Dissipation
rungs.physical_delta: Exact algebraic computation of post-sticking angular speed and kinetic energy loss.
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Exact algebraic fractions and mechanical energy difference

rungs.level_name: Multi-Concept Rigid Body Translation and Angular Reconfiguration
rungs.physical_delta: Continuous radial relocation of crawling mass across rotating disc exercising time-dependent moment of inertia and angular acceleration.
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Variable moment of inertia function I(r) = 1/2 M R^2 + m r^2 and work done by crawler
